lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 你看手机了吗？有一条消息。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn shǒujī le ma? Yǒu yī tiáo xiāoxi.
lines.english: Did you check your phone? There's a message.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 是李华。他说明天不来上班。
lines.pinyin: Shì Lǐ Huá. Tā shuō míngtiān bù lái shàngbān.
lines.english: It's from Li Hua. He says he's not coming to work tomorrow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Méi shuō. Zhǐ shuō yǒu shì qǐngjià.
lines.english: Didn't say. Just said he has something and requests leave.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ huí ge xiāoxi wènwen ba.
lines.english: Then I'll reply with a message to ask.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, gàosu wǒ tā zěnme shuō.
lines.english: OK, tell me what he says.
